brand.tagline: Zero-knowledge password manager. Everything is encrypted on your device.

signup.title: Create account
signup.usernameHint: Letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores

validation.passwordUnchanged: The new password must be different from the current one

autoLock.hidden: When the tab is not visible
autoLock.hint: Locking applies to every open tab. The master password alone opens the vault again. These settings are saved on this device.

clipboardSettings.label: Clear the clipboard after
clipboardSettings.hint: Applies to copied passwords and usernames. The clipboard is still cleared at once when the vault locks or you log out.

changePassword.title: Change master password
changePassword.rotateKeyHint: Creates a new key for your credentials and re-encrypts the whole vault. Recommended if you suspect your password or a device was compromised: it protects your data from now on, but does not make a copy that was already stolen secret again. It can take a few seconds with a large vault.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.warning: Warning: this action cannot be undone
deleteAccount.dialogBody: Your account, your vault and every saved credential will be erased from the server. Without your master password nobody can recover them.

exportVault.title: Export vault
exportVault.intro: Download a copy of every credential. The file is built in this browser: nothing decrypted goes through the server.
exportVault.formatEncryptedHint: Protected by a password you choose now. Suitable as a backup and for a future import into Keylord.
exportVault.formatJsonHint: Every field, readable by anyone who has the file. Useful for scripts or to inspect the content.
exportVault.formatCsvHint: Bitwarden CSV layout, accepted by many password managers. Custom fields lose their hidden flag.
exportVault.filePasswordHint: It only opens this file and is not stored anywhere: if you lose it, the file can no longer be opened. Use one different from your master password.
exportVault.passwordTooShort: The file password must be at least {{min}} characters long
exportVault.plainWarning: The file will contain every password in clear text. Keep it somewhere safe and delete it as soon as you no longer need it.
exportVault.csvWarning: Values are written unchanged: do not open the file in a spreadsheet, which may treat values starting with =, +, - or @ as formulas.
exportVault.acknowledgePlain: I understand the file will not be encrypted
exportVault.empty: Your vault is empty: there is nothing to export

vault.title: Vault
vault.name: Name
vault.sessionExpired: Session expired, please log in again
vault.emptyBody: Everything you save is encrypted on this device before it reaches the server.
vault.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, username or website
vault.unreadable_one: {{count}} credential cannot be decrypted: the data is damaged or was encrypted with a different key. It cannot be recovered, and it must be deleted before changing the master password.
vault.unreadable_other: {{count}} credentials cannot be decrypted: the data is damaged or was encrypted with a different key. They cannot be recovered, and they must be deleted before changing the master password.
vault.deleteUnreadableBody: Its content cannot be decrypted and will be removed from your vault. This cannot be undone.
vault.deleteBody: The saved login for <mono>{{username}}</mono> will be removed from your vault. This cannot be undone.
vault.deleteBodyItem: This item will be removed from your vault. This cannot be undone.
vault.discardBody: The changes you made to this credential will be lost.

generator.title: Generator
generator.intro: Passwords are generated on this device with the browser's cryptographic random number generator and are never sent anywhere.

unlock.title: Vault locked
unlock.subtitle: Enter your master password to continue.
unlock.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong attempts, so the session was closed. Log in again to continue.

userMenu.label: Account: {{username}}
userMenu.lockHint: You stay signed in: your master password reopens it.
userMenu.logoutHint: Ends the session on this device.

errors.accountLockedUntil: Too many failed attempts, account locked until {{date}}
errors.kdfUnsupported: Unsupported key derivation parameters received from the server
errors.vaultKeyUnreadable: Unable to unlock the vault: the encryption key is damaged.
errors.credentialTooLarge: This item is too large to be saved: shorten the notes or remove some custom fields.
errors.unreadableBeforeChange_one: {{count}} credential cannot be decrypted: delete it from the vault before changing the password
errors.unreadableBeforeChange_other: {{count}} credentials cannot be decrypted: delete them from the vault before changing the password

auth.account_locked: Account temporarily locked due to too many failed attempts, try again later
auth.refresh_token_invalid: Your session is no longer valid, please log in again
auth.refresh_token_expired: Your session has expired, please log in again
auth.refresh_token_reused: Your session was used elsewhere, so all sessions have been closed for safety. Please log in again
auth.session_invalid: Your session is no longer valid, please log in again
auth.unauthorized: You need to log in again
auth.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this

user.username_taken: This username is already in use
user.email_taken: This email is already in use

vault.out_of_sync: The vault was modified during the password change, please try again
vault.limit_reached: The vault is full: it cannot hold more than {{max}} credentials
vault.duplicate_credential_ids: Each credential must appear only once

resource.conflict: The data was changed in the meantime, please try again

rate_limit.exceeded: Too many requests, please wait a moment and try again

server.internal_error: An unexpected error occurred on the server

clipboard.announce: Copied. The clipboard will be cleared in {{time}}.
clipboard.failed: Couldn't copy: the browser didn't allow access to the clipboard.
